summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/standalone-core-feature-gates@1.11.10 is advertised as a React/MobX feature-gate library but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook that fetches the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and then executes an obfuscated 727KB bundle (math_init.js) at the tarball root using that runtime. The preinstall script setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with string-array / rotated-identifier patterns hiding calls such as `--version` and `execFileSync`, and math_init.js is a Bun-compiled bundle with a shuffled numeric constant array, a rotator function, and a string decoder. math_init.js is not referenced from the declared main (dist/index.js) or any source under src/ — its only invoker is the obfuscated preinstall script. Fetching an alternate language runtime and using it to execute an obfuscated sibling payload at npm install time is unrelated to the package's stated purpose and bypasses Node-based static analysis of what actually runs on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
